## Bug fix PR

<!-- Bugs must be reported as GitHub issues first. See docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#contribution-policy -->

## Linked issue (required)

Fixes #<!-- issue number -->

- [ ] The issue exists and was confirmed by a maintainer
- [ ] I was assigned to the issue (or commented and received a go-ahead)

## Root cause

<!-- What caused the bug? Be specific: file, function, condition. -->

## Fix

<!-- How does this change fix the root cause? -->

## Evidence

<!-- Logs, screenshots, or failing test output showing the bug before the fix and the result after -->

## Required

- [ ] Regression test that fails without the fix and passes with it (`tests/unit/` or `tests/integration/`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]` describing the fix and root cause
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] No unrelated changes

## Contribution integrity

- [ ] I reproduced the bug locally
- [ ] I can explain every line of this PR
- [ ] AI/LLM assistance: <!-- none / describe which tools and how they were used -->
